title: Better Map per-source recipe — YAML frontmatter schema
description: Machine-readable contract for the YAML frontmatter at the top of every per-source recipe file (docs/recipes/<source-id>/<layer-id>.md). Authored by hand; validated in CI by scripts/check-recipe-schema.py (which ALSO checks the six markdown body sections required by ROADMAP §3 E5). The Phase 1 generator emits docs/_machine/recipes/index.yaml from the union of these frontmatter blocks. See ROADMAP §3 E5 + §7e.

schema_version.description: Schema version this recipe declares against. Phase 1 is version 1.

id.description: Stable recipe id, MUST equal <source.id>--<layer.id> (the path-derived id). Used as the dedup key in index.yaml.

source.description: Which Splunk source pattern this recipe consumes. The 'id' is the directory name under docs/recipes/ and the row in the ROADMAP §3 E5 matrix.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Matches the docs/recipes/<id>/ directory name.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the docs site nav.

pattern.description: Broader category. Drives doc grouping and downstream llms.txt classification.

layer.description: Which Better Map layer type this recipe drives. MUST match the filename (<layer.id>.md) and be one of the ten core layer types tracked in the ROADMAP §3 E5 matrix.

status.description: Verification state of the SPL recipe. 'verified' means the SPL has been dispatched against a real Splunk install (named in verified_against) and confirmed to dispatch without parse error and return the documented fields. 'unverified' is reserved for recipes authored from documentation only; 'deferred' for matrix cells the team has explicitly chosen not to ship in this release.

last_verified_iso8601.description: ISO-8601 date the SPL was last dispatched against a real Splunk install. MUST be the day of the most recent verification, NOT the file's commit date.

verified_against.description: What 'verified' actually means for THIS recipe. The Splunk version + app context the SPL was dispatched in. NULL is only acceptable when status is 'deferred' or 'unverified'.

splunk_version.description: Splunk Enterprise / Cloud version string the SPL was dispatched against.

splunk_tenant_name_hash.description: Short, non-PII identifier of the lab tenant (e.g. 'rev:test'). Does NOT include hostname, customer name, or tokens.

splunk_app.description: App context the dispatch happened in (e.g. 'search', 'Splunk_TA_cisco_meraki').

splunk_apps_required.description: Splunk apps / TAs that the customer needs installed for THIS recipe's SPL to return data. An empty array means the recipe runs on a vanilla Splunk install with no add-ons.

id.description: Splunk app id (the value of [package] id in app.conf) OR 'builtin:<feature>' for vanilla-install features like iplocation.

optional.description: If true, the recipe still works without this app but with reduced enrichment.

version_min.description: Minimum app version. Optional; omit when 'any current version' is acceptable.

expected_fields.description: The field contract for the panel. Every field the recipe's SPL produces and the formatter binds to. The validator cross-checks that every entry here appears in the markdown body's 'Expected fields' table.

example.description: A representative example value, as a string. Used to populate the field-contract table in the markdown body.

drives_formatter_option.description: Optional cross-link: which formatter option this field is intended to feed (e.g. 'latitudeField'). Must be a property in docs/_machine/formatter-schema.json when present.

required_formatter_options.description: Minimum set of formatter options the recipe configures. Every entry MUST be a property name in docs/_machine/formatter-schema.json (the validator cross-checks).

ot_safety_relevant.description: Per /.cursor/rules/ot-safety.mdc, is any signal in this recipe SIS-related (safety_related=Y) or sourced from OT Level 0/1/2? If true, the recipe MUST include an 'OT safety' note in section 6 Gotchas.

references.description: Cross-references to source-of-truth files (skills, integrations YAML, other docs). Optional.
